summary: Independent Luna review of PR #1293 head 17f309e1 remains NO-GO: raw-byte systemd relevance inference is bypassable, FIFO entries can block inventory reads, and contract JSON loading bypasses the 64 KiB bound.
validation: Exact head 17f309e13e95a1993e1e9a5c8eb2f1fef72f5cfd reviewed against base efb9faac0606e02b7cac8e36e716f1ede9a50fb6.
Reviewer reproduced a verifier hang by placing a FIFO in an allowed unrelated systemd inventory directory.
Systemd token detection was assessed against continuations, environment expansion, and EnvironmentFile indirection and cannot establish semantic confinement.
Exact-head Validate, guard, and ARC classifier pass; protected ARC producer remains queued.
blockers: Remove or replace raw-byte systemd relevance inference; define the verifier boundary around exact managed runner units and exact sudo-callable commands, explicitly treating unrelated root-managed services and root compromise as out of scope.
Reject non-regular inventory entries before any blocking open/read and add FIFO/device/socket regression coverage.
Load contract JSON through a bounded no-follow descriptor path and reject oversized input before unbounded allocation.
next_action: Return to Luna code owner for loop-5 simplification and bounded type-safe reads, then independently re-review the exact head.

issues.title: Raw systemd relevance inference is semantically bypassable
issues.details: Raw contiguous token scanning cannot account for line continuations, environment composition, or EnvironmentFile indirection; narrow the stated boundary instead of implementing a partial parser.

issues.title: Inventory reads can block indefinitely on non-regular entries
issues.details: An unrelated FIFO is opened O_RDONLY before type rejection and hangs the verifier; validate type via no-follow metadata before opening.

issues.title: Contract JSON load bypasses descriptor size bound
issues.details: load_json uses an unbounded stream read, allowing memory exhaustion before the verifier applies bounded evidence handling.
